notes: Tail case, known issue (known_issues.json U1/U2). U1 recoloured a whole person and said 'left' for the front-right dancer -> recolour her black bolero jacket (SAM3 v2 garment mask). U2 replaced a dancer with an outfit -> replace the red-haired center dancer's gold cropped jacket (SAM3 v2, bikini top excluded) with a white fringed vest. U3 speaker was between U1's legs (not center) and mostly occluded -> retargeted to the unoccluded small black equipment box on the stage floor at the left (v2).
